chapter: The band's later history and Cootie Williams
title: Charlie Lipscomb, Cootie's teacher, and the band's succession
summary: Lipscomb taught Cootie Williams and took over the band, which passed to Langston.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was asking about the Cootie Williams teacher. This man did teach Cootie. He was in Lipson. Lipson was really his teacher. I didn't know for sure if that was true.
His name was Charlie Lipson. That's right. He did teach Cootie.

No, he's not. Oh, he's not living. He's not living. Now, he turned the band over to Lancaster. He's taken the band after I had given it up and turned it over to Lancaster. In other words, Lancaster's taken it up. Yes.
Cootie Williams played with me quite a bit.
